title: Owner-reviewed ordinary supplier goods return transcription

items.description: Original plain decimal text in the handoff base unit, at most three decimal places. Runtime also accepts fullwidth digits and surrounding whitespace; an empty omitted line means zero only after owner review.

total.description: Original TWD credit as plain decimal text, at most two decimal places, or empty if absent. Runtime compares original procurement allocation, never a guessed total.

$comment: Use the exact selected owner handoff; preserve source and epoch. This project-specific transcription fills the ordinary non-lot return form only. It has no financial operation ID or write authority. It is separate from pos-supplier-return-draft/v1 for selected lots. Owner review and the explicit goods-return confirmation remain mandatory. No external interoperability acceptance is claimed.
